intent: fix thermal throttling and system stutters
suggested_solution: Run HWINFO in 'Sensors-only' mode with a polling period of approximately 500 ms.
Disabling C1E (CPU idle state) in ThrottleStop has resolved microstutters.
Replacing thermal paste on both CPU and GPU, as well as using liquid thermal pads for GPU memory chips and VRM/power delivery chips, has improved thermal performance and reduced thermal throttling.
Setting NVIDIA Low Latency Mode to Ultra reduces or removes microstutters.
